name: Question 1
worked_solution:
First, we find the $\text{GCF}$ of the three terms:

$$
\text{GCF}(2{t}^{2},5t{v}^{3},6{v}^{2})=1
$$

Since the $\text{GCF}$ of the three terms is $1$, the given expression cannot be factored any further.
